events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 10
to 18 feet expected in the surf zone. For the Coastal Flood
Warning, 2 to 4 feet or more of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...Northampton.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Warning, until 5 AM EST Friday.
For the High Surf Advisory, until 1 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Major flooding is expected resulting in extreme
inundation. Water will be 2 to 4 feet or more above ground
level in flooded areas. Numerous homes and businesses could be
flooded. Many roads across the area may become impassable for
an extended period of time causing many neighborhoods to
become flooded and isolated. Life threatening flooding will
extend well inland from the waterfront and shoreline. Should
evacuations become necessary, follow the advice of local
officials for evacuation information.

events.summary:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 10
to 16 feet expected in the surf zone. For the Coastal Flood
Warning, up to 2 feet of inundation above ground level
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...Eastern Currituck County.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Warning, until 11 AM EST this
morning. For the High Surf Advisory, until 7 AM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Moderate to locally major flooding of vulnerable
areas will result in an elevated threat of property damage to
homes and businesses near the waterfront and shoreline. Water
will be up to 2 feet above ground level in some areas
resulting in a sufficient depth to close numerous roads and
threaten homes and businesses. Flooding will extend inland
from the waterfront along tidal rivers and bays resulting in
some road closures and flooding of vehicles. Dangerous
swimming and surfing conditions and localized beach erosion.
